notes: D integrates durable role intent, independent Security join lifetime, common captured path permission and physical passage admissions; it does not replace all phase coordinators with a generic task graph.

Normal polling 30/60/90 ticks and the C execution allowance remain. Persistent passage claims remove full-unit enumeration per actor resolution; tile hooks reuse the bound order and skip ingress observation for actors without active captured ingress.

CPU Execution includes nested work. ExecutionMaintenance overlaps urgent dispatch; sum only if urgent=0. Totals and maxima include warmup; percentiles retain the last 2048 samples; service counters accumulate across cases.

400 LOW actors mainly queue at one opening. This does not measure 400 simultaneous active CQB combatants. No controlled improvement percentage is inferred from independently randomized worlds and phase progress.
unstartedMoves filters requests not started; unstartedMoveDetails is bounded to 24 unfinished movement intents and may also include work previously started then blocked.

Near-mouth long50 retained five repeated Assault retry requests; diagnostic repetition used a different generated world and did not reproduce the long retry. Do not treat this as proof all long stalls are solved.

Two hidden diagnostic launches stopped before map creation because native Root applied background preferences after the audit startup flag. Only identified test PIDs were stopped; audit-only Prefs.RunInBackground fixes startup.
Native multi-map, High actual formations, multiple entries, sustained combat, bidirectional retreat and in-progress full save/load remain E integration coverage.

The final code differs from measured 372AFF only in the missing-structure cleanup guard for retired unit ingress. A real-class retired-unit regression checks the new branch; normal native functional and performance records retain their actual measured DLL hash.

Final long50 summary has two unstarted requests, but bounded detail also shows eight previously started Approach retry requests of age209/269 without a rejected tile. An empty passage queue is not proof every movement intention completes.
Build/binding test tail overlapped the first 400 case. Independent world seeds, actor statistics, phases and host activity make the samples unsuitable for a controlled percentage claim.

retestAfterConcurrentWork.context: User reported other work during prior measurements and requested one retest. No source changes, builds or other test suites were run during this performance retest.
notes: One 50-pawn 6000-tick sample and one sample per speed (1x and3x) for400 pawns, with300 warmup ticks. Historical results remain intact.
Independently generated worlds and progress are not identical. FPS and actual CPU improve while50-pawn TPS is lower; do not infer CPU throughput from requested speed alone.
Vanilla TickManager.TickRateMultiplier respects TimeSlower.ForcedNormalSpeed. Forced-slow ticks were not counted, so no definite cause for the50-pawn TPS change is claimed.
This retest improves steady tick p95 in400 pawns, but the298.122ms maximum remains. No general claim of reduced worst tick or completely resolved movement stalls.
Name-generation failures and one no-nodes path diagnostic are recorded separately from exception logs. The400 scenario is mostly shared opening waits, not400 active CQB combatants.
